Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

Load data
```{r}
mega_clusters = read.csv("~/Downloads/Spatial_Gobbini/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")
entropy_clusters = read.csv("~/Downloads/Spatial_Gobbini/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv")
```

Load RNASeq data
```{r}
counts = read.csv("../../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/counts_raw.csv", row.names = 1) 
traitData = read.csv("../../LungPredict2/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv")
traitData = traitData[traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk %in% colnames(counts),] # Filter for patients with RNAseq
counts = counts[,traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk] #Order samples on counts based on clinical data
all.equal(traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk, colnames(counts)) #Verify samples from counts are in the correct order
```

Filter to only patients with RNAseq
```{r}
### Take values of "entropy"
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 

### Take values of "Nombre_cluster_type_mm2"
df_area = mega_clusters %>%
  dplyr::filter(Dispo_bluk %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dispo_bluk, Cluster_type, Nombre_cluster_type_mm2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster_type,
    values_from = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Dispo_bluk") 
```

Associate with response
```{r}
anova_test = function(data, trait_name, y_name, pval = 0.05, file_name){
  print("Performing one way ANOVA test...................................")
  data$y = data[,y_name]
  data$trait = as.factor(data[,trait_name])
  model  <- lm(y ~ trait, data = data)
  res.aov <- data %>% rstatix::anova_test(y ~ trait)
  if(round(res.aov$p, 5) <= pval){
    print("Significant test found!")
    pdf(paste0("ANOVA_", file_name))
    print(ggplot(data, aes(x=trait, y=y, fill=trait)) +
            geom_violin(width=0.6) +
            geom_boxplot(width=0.07, color="black", alpha=0.2) +
            scale_fill_brewer() +
            geom_smooth(aes(x=trait, y=y), method = "loess") +
            ylab(paste0("Values for ", y_name)) +
            xlab(paste0("Clinical trait: ", trait_name)) +
            labs(title="One way ANOVA test",
                 subtitle=rstatix::get_test_label(res.aov, detailed = TRUE)) +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
                  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90)))
    dev.off()
  }
}

coldata = traitData[traitData$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk%in%rownames(df_area),]

### Area megacluster
for (i in colnames(df_area)) {
  anova_test(df_area %>% dplyr::mutate(Response = coldata$R.NR), "Response", i, pval = 5, file_name = paste0("Area_", i))
}

### Entropy
for (i in colnames(df_entropy)) {
  anova_test(df_entropy %>% dplyr::mutate(Response = coldata$R.NR), "Response", i, pval = 5, file_name = paste0("Entropy_", i))
}
```

Save files
```{r}
write.csv(df_area, file = "../input/MegaClusters_area.csv")
write.csv(df_entropy, file = "../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv")
```

Match with CD8 proportion from imaging
```{r}
load("../input/Spatial_features.RData")
traitData = traitData %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Samples = paste0("Patient_", traitData$AN))
coldata = traitData[traitData$Samples %in% rownames(data_spatial$Stroma),]
coldata = coldata[match(rownames(data_spatial$Stroma), coldata$Samples),]
all.equal(coldata$Samples, rownames(data_spatial$Stroma))

data_spatial$Stroma = data_spatial$Stroma %>%
  dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Samples = coldata$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Samples")

data_spatial$Stroma = data_spatial$Stroma[coldata$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk,]
all.equal(coldata$N_Raw_matrice_Bulk, rownames(data_spatial$Stroma))

df_area = df_area[rownames(df_area)%in%rownames(data_spatial$Stroma),]
df_entropy = df_entropy[rownames(df_entropy)%in%rownames(data_spatial$Stroma),]
```
